answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens before validating actions. Verifiers sample interaction graphs for topological cut verifications, isolating suspicious clusters. If colluding nodes fabricate consensus, multi-agent auditing exposes the cut, pushing attacker payoff to its absolute nadir via total stake slashing. This enforces a superlinear attacker cost: like a comet burning past an orbital ledge, forged clusters swiftly collapse economically.
